title: UC San Diego entwickelt KI-Agenten für Physik und Quantencomputing
snippet: Die University of California San Diego (UCSD) wird im Rahmen der Genesis Mission des US-Energieministeriums (DOE) ein neues Projekt zur Beschleunigung der Grundlagenforschung in Physik und Quantencomputing durch intelligente KI-Agenten leiten. title: Santa Barbara City Council will discuss the termination of the Flock Safety contract and possible replacement with Verkada cameras
snippet: Dr. Giovanni Vigna, a distinguished professor of Computer Science at UC Santa Barbara who specializes in surveillance and vulnerability assessment research, commented on the Santa Barbara Police Department's proposed transition to Verkada CB53 cameras, which utilize AI-powered search features [12.1.1].
